statements.t: “Additionally, our common stock began trading on the OTCQB Venture Market in July, and we were selected as the sole industrial partner on three DOE Project GENESIS grants focused on artificial intelligence-enabled repository analysis.

Subsequent to quarter-end, on October 1, 2026, the Company announced that the Texas Railroad Commission had issued a drilling permit, allowing the project to advance toward construction and field activities.

In July 2026, the Company’s common stock was approved for quotation on the OTCQB Venture Market under the symbol “DBHL.” On July 23, 2026, Deep Isolation was selected as the sole industrial partner on three competitive grants under DOE’s Project GENESIS program.
Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by the excluded items.
